description: This PHP source file defines the AddressRule class, which extends BaseRule to handle parsing and refining address-related panels in the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM UI. It provides methods to identify address fields, manipulate address panels, and maintain address field consistency across different views.

classes.name: AddressRule
classes.description: A utility class that refines and manipulates address-related fields within form panels for different views, ensuring correct display and data integrity during UI rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for AddressRule class; currently empty.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Processes input panels to handle address fields appropriately depending on the view (DetailView, EditView), including modifying or removing certain address-related fields.

methods.name: hasAddressFieldsIntact
methods.description: Checks whether all essential address fields (street, city, state, country, postalcode) are present within a specific address panel, indicating completeness.

methods.name: removeStreetFieldOverride
methods.description: Replaces array definitions of specific street address fields with string identifiers to ensure proper rendering.
